mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_accept_apply_detail d INNER JOIN tb_accept_apply a ON d.ACCEPT_APPLY_NO = a.APPLY_NO INNER JOIN tb_purchase_contract pc ON a.PURCHASE_CONTRACT_NO = pc.APPLY_NO WHERE a.STATUS = 1 AND a.ACCEPT_CATEGORY = 1 AND d.IS_DELETED = 0 AND a.IS_DELETED = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_settlement_order s WHERE s.IS_DELETED = 0 AND s.STATUS >= 1 AND JSON_CONTAINS(s.ACCEPT_DETAIL_IDS, CAST(d.ID AS JSON)) )
AND pc.SUPPLIER_NO = #{supplierNo}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_accept_apply_detail d INNER JOIN tb_accept_apply a ON d.ACCEPT_APPLY_NO = a.APPLY_NO INNER JOIN tb_bom_purchase_contract bc ON a.BOM_PURCHASE_CONTRACT_NO = bc.APPLY_NO WHERE a.STATUS = 1 AND a.ACCEPT_CATEGORY = 2 AND d.IS_DELETED = 0 AND a.IS_DELETED = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_settlement_order s WHERE s.IS_DELETED = 0 AND s.STATUS >= 1 AND JSON_CONTAINS(s.ACCEPT_DETAIL_IDS, CAST(d.ID AS JSON)) )
AND bc.SUPPLIER_NO = #{supplierNo}
SELECT SUPPLIER_NO FROM tb_contract_supplier WHERE ID = #{supplierId} AND IFNULL(IS_DELETED, 0) = 0
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(RIGHT(SETTLEMENT_NO, 4) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) FROM tb_settlement_order WHERE SETTLEMENT_NO LIKE CONCAT('S', #{dateStr}, '%') FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_settlement_order_attachment (SETTLEMENT_ID, ATTACHMENT_ID, CREATE_TIME, IS_DELETED) VALUES (#{settlementId}, #{attachmentId}, NOW(), 0)

INSERT INTO tb_settlement_invoice_line ( ID, SETTLEMENT_ID, INVOICE_NO, INVOICE_DATE, PROJECT_NAME, PART_NO, TAX_RATE, AMOUNT, TAX_AMOUNT, TOTAL_AMOUNT, ATTACHMENT_ID, ACCEPT_APPLY_NO, IS_DELETED ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{settlementId}, #{invoiceNo}, #{invoiceDate}, #{projectName}, #{partNo}, #{taxRate}, #{amount}, #{taxAmount}, #{totalAmount}, #{attachmentId}, #{acceptApplyNo}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT ud.SUPPLIER_COMPANY_ID FROM tb_user_detail ud WHERE ud.USER_ID = #{userId} AND IFNULL(ud.IS_DELETED, 0) = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_settlement_order SET STATUS = #{status} WHERE ID = #{id}
UPDATE tb_settlement_order SET IS_DELETED = 1 WHERE ID = #{id} AND STATUS = 0
mapper.select: SELECT l.ID AS id, l.SETTLEMENT_ID AS settlementId, l.INVOICE_NO AS invoiceNo, l.INVOICE_DATE AS invoiceDate, l.PROJECT_NAME AS projectName, l.PART_NO AS partNo, l.TAX_RATE AS taxRate, l.AMOUNT AS amount, l.TAX_AMOUNT AS taxAmount, l.TOTAL_AMOUNT AS totalAmount, l.ATTACHMENT_ID AS attachmentId, l.ACCEPT_APPLY_NO AS acceptApplyNo, f.NAME AS attachmentName, f.URL AS attachmentUrl FROM tb_settlement_invoice_line l LEFT JOIN tb_flow_file f ON l.ATTACHMENT_ID = f.ID WHERE l.SETTLEMENT_ID = #{settlementId} AND l.IS_DELETED = 0

SELECT d.ID AS id, d.ID AS accept_detail_id, d.PARTS_NO AS parts_no, d.PARTS_NAME AS parts_name, d.REMARK AS remark, d.UNIT_NAME AS unit, d.QUANTITY AS quantity, d.TOTAL_PRICE_RMB AS amount, a.APPLY_NO AS accept_apply_no FROM tb_settlement_order s INNER JOIN tb_accept_apply_detail d ON JSON_CONTAINS(s.ACCEPT_DETAIL_IDS, CAST(d.ID AS JSON)) INNER JOIN tb_accept_apply a ON d.ACCEPT_APPLY_NO = a.APPLY_NO WHERE s.ID = #{settlementId} AND s.IS_DELETED = 0
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM tb_user_detail ud WHERE ud.USER_ID = #{userId} AND IFNULL(ud.IS_DELETED, 0) = 0 AND ud.IS_SUPPLIER_ADMIN IN ('是', '1', 'true')
SELECT f.ID AS id, f.NAME AS name, f.URL AS url FROM tb_flow_file f WHERE f.business_id = #{settlementId} AND f.business_name = 'completionDoc' AND IFNULL(f.is_deleted, 0) = 0
SELECT remark FROM tb_settlement_order WHERE ID = #{settlementId} AND IFNULL(IS_DELETED, 0) = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_flow_file (id, business_id, business_name, url, name, create_user, create_time, status, is_deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{businessId}, #{businessName}, #{url}, #{name}, #{createUser}, NOW(), '1', 0)
